subject.title: [Bug]: diagnostics-otel reuses a signal-qualified OTLP endpoint for all enabled signals, POSTing metrics/logs to the traces endpoint

question: Should maintainers accept shared-endpoint per-signal normalization and choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101655 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98911 as the canonical landing PR?
rationale: The source bug is clear and the OTLP contract supports the fix direction, but the remaining choice is compatibility-sensitive fallback behavior plus duplicate PR selection.

options.title: Land the active proven PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101655 as canonical if maintainers accept the shared-endpoint compatibility change and its proof remains current.

options.title: Revive the older candidate
options.body: Ask for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98911 to be rebased and treated as canonical instead.

options.title: Preserve exact shared URL reuse
options.body: Request a redesigned fix that warns or skips mismatched shared signal paths while keeping exact shared URL reuse as the default.

recommendation.title: Land the active proven PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101655 as canonical if maintainers accept the shared-endpoint compatibility change and its proof remains current.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current signal-qualified endpoint preservation behavior and has recent diagnostics-otel ownership signals.
